rationale: Open faulted branch l23 to isolate the fault between b2 and b3. Close the normally-open tie_24 (b2-b4) to re-energize b4 and, through l34, b3. The resulting energized graph s-b1-b2-b4-b3 is radial and restores all load buses (b2 priority 3, b3 priority 5, b4 priority 2), yielding priority_restored = 10 which meets min_priority_restored = 10, with 170 kW of load restored.
